newsitem.title: USA: ARCO pipeline unit, All American form pact.
newsitem.headline: ARCO pipeline unit, All American form pact.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co unit, ARCO Pipe Line Co, on Thursday said it plans to work with All American Pipeline Co on seeking shipper commitments for an oil pipeline transport service in California.
In a letter agreement, the companies outlined plans to operate their individual pipelines as part of the service under a joint tariff.
All American would transport crude oil from the San Joaquin Valley to Cadiz, Calif. where it would be transferred to ARCO Pipe Line for delivery to the Los Angeles Basin.
